answer: Under pairwise interlock minting, every new identity must gather an interactive co-signature from each identity enrolled in the past 24 hours, like a haven whose gate needs every resident's mark. The handshake set carries a rotating pigment nonce, so stale proofs are worthless. Honest single joiners exchange one fresh batch per epoch near the nadir of their cost curve, roughly fifty handshakes. An attacker minting n fakes must complete and store about n² mutual signatures: 100 fakes need 10,000 sessions, making forgery quadratic while honest admission stays linear and cheap.
